Earlier this year in May, OpenAI launched a dedicated mobile application version for enterprise users. Now SpaceXAI is taking the same approach with Grok.

Grok for Intune is now available

This enterprise-exclusive app is called Grok for Intune. SpaceXAI states that the newly launched dedicated application is "the Microsoft Intune version of Grok, the AI assistant under xAI — specifically designed for organisations that manage applications and data through Intune".

The company pointed out: "It supports Intune mobile application management, adheres to enterprise application protection policies, and signs in with corporate email."

SpaceXAI highlights that Grok for Intune has the following features:

AI assistant — Ask anything, get instant responses; conduct in-depth web research, or tackle difficult problems in mathematics, science, and coding. Upload files and photos, or paste links, and let Grok analyse and explain the content. Grok Imagine generates impressive images from simple text prompts, or upload images for Grok to edit — remove objects, change scenes, or apply any artistic style. Create short videos with sound effects using text prompts, or transform static photos into videos. Voice mode — Converse with Grok and get natural, fluid voice responses without lifting a finger. Live camera: Share what you see before you, and let Grok analyse and reason in real time. Real-time information — By accessing the web and X platform data, Grok's responses stay on top of the latest news, trends, and developments across all topics. Designed for managed devices — Deployed and configured by enterprise IT teams through Microsoft Intune. Adheres to enterprise application protection policies, including restrictions on storage, sharing, and data transmission. Signs in with corporate email. No in-app purchases.

Grok for Intune is now available on the App Store.
